entities.summary: Rachele Sangiuliano is a retired female volleyball player who represented Italy in the early 2000s. She was a member of the Women's National Team that won the gold medal at the 2002 World Championship in Germany. After retiring from volleyball, she became a television presenter. Sangiuliano was inducted into the Italian Volleyball Hall of Fame in 2022.
